# .github

Repository automation, workflow, and Copilot-specific instruction files.

## Available Customizations

### Instructions

- [instructions/recurring-deliverables.instructions.md](instructions/recurring-deliverables.instructions.md) - Auto-attached workflow guidance for Stage 2 weekly reports, supervisor medallion deliverables, linked indexes, and manifest-backed output refreshes.

### Prompts

- [prompts/stage2-weekly-report.prompt.md](prompts/stage2-weekly-report.prompt.md) - Slash prompt for creating, refreshing, or extending a Stage 2 weekly report with repo-aligned evidence gathering.
- [prompts/stage2-weekly-report-from-commits.prompt.md](prompts/stage2-weekly-report-from-commits.prompt.md) - Slash prompt for drafting a Stage 2 weekly report from recent commits, touched files, validation evidence, and linked literature.
- [prompts/supervisor-package-refresh.prompt.md](prompts/supervisor-package-refresh.prompt.md) - Slash prompt for refreshing the supervisor report package while keeping the manifest, generated artifacts, and companion docs in sync.

## How To Use

- Use instructions for behavior that should apply automatically on matching files.
- Use prompts when you want a named slash command in chat for a repeatable workflow.
- Start with the weekly-report prompt for structured Stage 2 reporting, use the commit-driven weekly-report prompt when you want the draft built from recent repo history, and use the supervisor-package prompt for diploma-defense or medallion-package refreshes.
